messages:
morgan: FYI — nightly perf run shows a ~12% regression when pack_qKV + epilogue fusion are enabled for long sequences (seq_len >= 1024). nvprof flame looks odd, more time spent in fused_qkv_epilogue_kernel than expected. attaching quick summary.

perf-bot: nightly-bench/model-x: run=2026-03-17T06:20Z, baseline=2026-03-10, delta=-12.3% tokens/s, CI failed on 3/10 shards. See /runs/2026-03-17/2171234567.

alex: can you paste the repro steps? is this only on Ampere p4d or on T4 too?

morgan: repro (quick):
```
# checkout branch with qkv pack + epilogue fusion
export MODEL=model-x
export SEQ=1536
./bench_runner --model $MODEL --seq $SEQ --batch 1 --kernel fused_qkv_epilogue_v4 --warmup 200 --iters 1000
```
On p4d I see 650 tokens/s vs baseline 740 tokens/s. On T4 it's ~8% regression but noisier.

sophie: interesting — does this correlate with increased L2 misses? any dram bandwidth spikes?

morgan: nvprof shows higher L2 and global load stalls. snapshot:
```
Kernel: fused_qkv_epilogue_v4
Elapsed: 14.2ms
L2_read_transactions: +28% vs baseline
global_load_throughput: +12%
```
So epilogue seems to be issuing more scattered stores/loads. Could be alignment or extra index math after packing.

jamal: did we change prefetching heuristics in the kernel chooser recently? I remember a tweak for paged-KV to prefetch more aggressively.

morgan: yeah, last week we flipped prefetch_threshold from 64->96 for seqs > 1024 to reduce page faults for paged-KV. I thought it helped; maybe combined with pack layout it's counterproductive.

alex: quick experiment: try forcing pack_qkv_v3 (no epilogue fusion) and compare. also run with binder=0 (disable L2 prefetch) and with GCOMM profiling.

morgan: did that — pack_qkv_v3 w/o epilogue fusion is back to baseline. disabling prefetch in kernel chooser recovers ~6% (so partial).

sophie: hypothesis: epilogue fusion added extra gather offsets (rope/bias applied per lane) that interacts badly with cache line alignment after qkv packing. If prefetch tries to pull too much it causes extra evictions.

jamal: makes sense. we should try two quick patches: 1) conservative prefetch when epilogue_fused=true, 2) align packed qkv rows to 128B to reduce cross-line gathers.

morgan: I'll run microbench for both patches tomorrow. will also instrument the fused kernel with perf counters to capture L1/TEX miss breakdown.

alex: also run the batcher with burst_size=1 and continuous batching disabled, to rule out batching heuristics amplifying the regression. we had a similar interaction last quarter where batching combined with prefetching inflated working set.

sophie: if we confirm alignment fix helps, let's add a short regression test: seq=1536, kernel=fused_qkv_epilogue_v4, assert tokens/s >= baseline * 0.95 and L2_read_txn delta < 10%.

morgan: good plan. tagging @jamal for kernel-chooser changes. I'll drop the nvprof trace in the thread (uploaded). :thumbsup:

perf-bot: nightly-bench note: rollback candidate flagged if perf < -10% for 24h.

jamal: I'll stub a PR for chooser that gates prefetch by epilogue flag. also prototyping 128B alignment pad on pack builder. will post perf numbers in this thread.

alex: thanks — if anyone finds a quick config that recovers on-prod, post it here so SRE can flip as emergency fallback. :thinking_face:
